result.instructions:
When the person asks for another agent, on another model or another harness, start it as a wsp thread with run, so it shows in their sidebar; your own subagent tool is for your own sub-steps. Each thread can own a slate, a live panel the person reads, presses and fills in: when they ask for a panel, dashboard, form, checklist, tracker or walkthrough, call slate_catalog, then slate_write naming the thread. Agents work on a project, a folder on one computer, as threads in the person's sidebar. Setup, every verb and the rules are in the wsp skill (`wsp mcp install --agent <id>` writes it). The agents this host runs threads on, the only values run takes as agent: claude, codex, opencode, cursor.
- A wsp thread starts every child with --notify me and ends its turn, and each child's finished line wakes it with that child's whole report, so nothing is polled.
- A caller that is not a wsp thread cannot be woken at all, so it takes the reply of one turn as the call returns, and hands work of more than one turn to a single coordinator thread in the project's folder on this computer.
- Start long work with your harness's own background road, which wakes you when it ends, and never with a shell &, which nothing tracks and which wakes nobody when it ends.
